purpose: Determine whether the canonical same-calendar-month seasonality prior failed because the high-score leg is intrinsically bad or because the exact low-score leg contains a genuine, executable seasonal-reversal long alpha.

research_window.validation_access: Only after all generation gates pass; a fixed diagnostic split inside consumed development history, never OOS.

signal.exact_score: Causal total log return in the same completed calendar month one year earlier, requiring at least 15 valid observations, unchanged from Cycle-009.
signal.known_prior_result: Cycle-009's highest-score Top-20 lost 1.250% absolute and 1.841% versus date control, with adverse excess in both broad blocks.
signal.frozen_post_hoc_direction: lower prior-year same-month return is better
signal.economic_hypothesis: The A-share result may be seasonal reversal rather than continuation: names that were weak in this calendar month last year may rebound while prior same-month winners suffer recurring supply.

anatomy.buckets: Within-date deterministic equal-count quintiles; Q1 is the lowest prior-year same-month return and Q5 the highest.
anatomy.response: Next legal open through twentieth completed-session close with accepted QD-010 actions and 20 bps per side.
anatomy.baseline: All exact score-valid eligible stocks on the same decision dates.
metrics: Q1 and Q5 versus all eligible

executable_translation.authorization: Only after all generation and validation gates pass.
executable_translation.selection_if_both_pass: The single frozen family is selected.
executable_translation.rule: Every 20 sessions rank eligible stocks by exact prior-year same-month return ascending, retain the lowest 20, and equal-weight the lowest 10 at the next legal open.

prohibited: changing year lag, month definition, minimum observations, score sign, buckets, Top-N, schedule, horizon, costs, universe, or liquidity floor
generic reversal, momentum, industry, market-state, or champion rescue
OOS, independent-validation, confirmation, or live language
